text: Diana was a Roman goddess. Her name appears on many sculptures in Celtic lands under Roman rule. Like the Greek goddess ARTEMIS, Diana was not Celtic in origin. Diana began as an Italic goddess of the open sky. Roman times made her a lunar divinity of the hunt. Legionnaires carried her name to Celtic lands. They renamed similar local goddesses after Diana. Many Celtic goddesses were absorbed under her name. Their personal names were lost. Often the original form cannot be known. Several wilderness goddesses kept their own names.
